properties.evidence: The 2026-08-23 fact counted five silent failures, said 'whether five is a normal rate is unknown', and listed the cheap habits that would have caught them - including 'read a background task's OWN output rather than the log it is still writing' and 'read back anything you wrote through an API before believing it landed'. Twelve days later a second session produced five more, two of them the exact instances the earlier fact named. It saw this coming and wrote down the countermeasure; the countermeasure was on the record and was not consulted at the moment it applied.
